Management Plan
-  management_plan_main_or_not_recorded
  - Hydration: maintain hydration with oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte) as advised
  - Diet during diarrhea: soft diet; avoid dairy, fish, meat, eggs while diarrheal
  - Soft-diet examples: crackers, toast, jam; then small amounts of boiled vegetables and mash
  - Reintroduction: after 48 hours with no diarrhea, can start introducing meat
  - Milk/dairy: milk not recommended during diarrhea; yogurt considered supportive (probiotics)
  - Probiotics: yogurt recommended as a probiotic option
  - Fluids: continue drinking plenty of water
  - Over-the-counter: Dioralyte available to replenish lost salts
  - Monitoring: if diarrhea persists for ~1 week or if blood in stool, consider stool sample
  - Dehydration warning: if 6–8 stools/day, risk of dehydration; may require hospital investigation/treatment
  - Documentation: all guidance available in app notes for reference
